source.title: WAC Leader Announcement (July 2023)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new WAC Leader. Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar will become the new Leader of the WCA Advisory Council (WAC). Abhijeet was already working as a member of the WAC.

Abhijeet was selected by the WCA Board, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2021.0%20-%20Councils.pdf) about WCA Councils.


We wish Abhijeet best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.


The new Leader is already promoted. Abhijeet was the only applicant we had and his candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1j1I4QAjxIpvVqmLFuY7-jOqqtukyVwoc/view) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: WCA 顾问理事会负责人任命公告（2023 年 7 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar 将成为 WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）的新负责人。Abhijeet 此前已是 WAC 成员。

WCA 董事会依照 WCA 理事会[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2021.0%20-%20Councils.pdf)第 4 节的规定选定了 Abhijeet。

祝 Abhijeet 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

新负责人已正式就任。Abhijeet 是这一职位的唯一申请者。有兴趣了解的成员可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1j1I4QAjxIpvVqmLFuY7-jOqqtukyVwoc/view)查看他的申请材料。
